name: Klapka

build.notes: He arrives at Lv63 with Def 50, so he can hold chokepoints right away. Sentinel is the natural Master step from Guardian's spear line.

Weight: Silver Spear +2 6 + Hexlock Shield 4 + Gale Ring 2 = 12 (extra 6). Ring off first if it can't stop a double.
